title: Dreams speedrunner swap Chinese version
description: Chinese Version of Dreams Speedrunner Swap plugin
body:
# 描述

这是一个dreams-speedrunner-swap的汉化版本
如果我有条件，我将会及时跟进原插件的更新，感谢支持，这里贴上原仓库：
https://github.com/muj3b/dreams-speedrunner-swap
食用方法：
1.下载文件
2.将文件复制到服务端下的plugins文件夹
3.运行服务端
感谢他们的付出！
原作者：muj3b
汉化作者：Flynn

本仓库遵循MIT协议

# DESCRIPTION(English Version)

This is a Chinese localization of dreams-speedrunner-swap.  
If circumstances allow, I will keep up with updates to the original plugin in a timely manner. Thank you for your support!  
Here is the original repository:  
https://github.com/muj3b/dreams-speedrunner-swap  
How to Use:
1.Download this file
2.Copy this file to the plugins folder in your server directory.
3.Run the server
My gratitude goes to their efforts!  
Original author: muj3b  
Chinese localization by: Flynn
